register.headline: Özden's further arrangement at 172 of Daniel's T-257 packing, 3.25e-3 below it
register.source_checks:
The issue says this repository's packing-witness verify, run unmodified on the witness, reports VERIFIED (exact-algebraic, 14706 pairs), and that verifier/sqcheck.py, an exact checker the author's lab wrote separately from this repository's code, reports VALID (exact rational) and prints the exact side rounded up. It says the two share only the unit-square, wall and non-overlap definitions.

This repository's packing-witness promote --strategy robust-rational at ef1af493 made the exact coordinates from the lab's decimal pose, n-172-decimal-pose.yaml, with center_dilation 1 and no dilation, so packing-witness verify is not independent of how they were rounded, as the issue says. The issue says the pair margins of about 2e-13 are the decimal pose's own, that only the squares that set the left wall, the bottom wall and the side touch them exactly, and that other squares near a wall clear it by up to about 1e-12. Before promotion sqcheck.py certified the decimal pose in interval arithmetic at its own side. No local-optimality, rigidity or formal check is claimed. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit:
Credit Doğa Özden (https://dogaozden.com/math/live/square-packing/), who reports a packing found from the registry's 172, Evan Daniel's packing (T-257, #845), taken from this repository's regularized known-best atlas, by basin hopping over local minima of Evan Daniel's ALM+SLP quench (https://github.com/evand/square-packing, MIT), compiled into the lab's search, its exact coordinates made by this repository's packing-witness promote. The issue asks that the improvement be credited to Özden, the base packing to its holders as the record lists them, and the local optimizer to Evan Daniel.

The issue says the search and its code were written and run by AI agents and that the checks were run by code that did not produce the packing; the issue and repository were prepared and posted by Özden's AI agent, which uses the account kenaznia-doga, and Özden directed the work. The best public Kaggle per-puzzle side the issue found at 172, 13.617935700905 (jazivxt), is above this and states no packing.
